def _plot_ice_lines(self, preds, values, pd_plot_idx, n_ice_to_plot,
                        individual_line_kw, lines_ravel, n_lines, rng):
        """Plot the subsampled ICE lines.

        Parameters
        ----------
        preds : ndarray of shape (n_instances, n_grid_points)
            The predictions computed for all points of the grid for a given
            feature for all samples in `X`.
        values : seq of 1d array
            The values of the grid for the feature.
        pd_plot_idx : int
            The sequential index of the plot. It will be unraveled to find the
            matching 2D position in the grid layout.
        n_ice_to_plot : int
            The number of ICE lines to plot.
        individual_line_kw : dict
            Dict with keywords passed when plotting the ICE lines.
        lines_ravel : ndarray of shape (n_lines,) dtype=object
            The raveled array of lines.
        n_lines : int
            The number of lines expected per plot.
        rng : np.random.RandomState
            The random state used to select the subsample.
        """
        # subsample ice
        ice_lines_idx = rng.choice(
            preds.shape[0], n_ice_to_plot, replace=False,
        )
        ice_lines_subsampled = preds[ice_lines_idx, :]
        # plot the subsampled ice
        for ice_idx, ice in enumerate(ice_lines_subsampled):
            line_idx = pd_plot_idx * n_lines + ice_idx
            lines_ravel[line_idx] = self.axes_.ravel()[pd_plot_idx].plot(
                values[0], ice.ravel(), **individual_line_kw
            )[0]
